concept_map.chapter_overview: Aaj hum NCERT Class 9 Mathematics ke Chapter 17 — पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल और आयतन — ko padhenge. Is hisse mein pehle लंब वृत्तीय शंकु ka वक्र और कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल (πrl aur πr(l+r)), phir गोला aur अधर्गोला ka पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल (4πr², 2πr², 3πr²), aur ant mein समान आधार-ऊँचाई वाले बेलन व शंकु ka volume comparison shuru karenge. Saari baatein activities, formulae aur NCERT examples se clear hongi.
concept_map.welcome: Good morning, class! Aaj Smart Board par Geometry ka ek bahut useful chapter shuru karte hain — पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल और आयतन. Socho: ice-cream cone, joker's topi, tent, bhutta, football, hemispherical dome — in sabka paper, paint ya canvas kitna lagega? Aaj hum wahi calculate karna seekhenge. Ready ho? Chalo shuru karte hain!

generated.say: Bacchon, ab tak hum congruent figures ko ek ke upar ek rakh kar solids bana rahe the — unhe prism kehte hain. Aaj ek naya solid dekhenge jo prism nahi hai — yeh pyramid family se related hai, aur iska special form hai लंब वृत्तीय शंकु, yani right circular cone. Activity yaad rakho: ek समकोण त्रिभुज OAB lo jisme angle O right angle ho. Ek lambi moti dori OA ke along chipkao, dono haathon se pakdo, aur triangle ko dori ke around kai baar ghumao. Jo aakriti banegi, woh ice-cream cone jaisi dikhegi — wahi right circular cone hai! Isme point A को शंकु का शीर्ष (vertex) kehte hain, OA ऊँचाई (height) h hoti hai, OB आधार की त्रिज्या (base radius) r hoti hai, aur AB तिर्यक ऊँचाई (slant height) l hoti hai. O आधार के वृत्त का केन्द्र (centre) hai. Dhyan do — har cone right circular nahi hota. Agar vertex se base-centre tak ki line base par perpendicular na ho, ya base circular na ho, toh woh लंब वृत्तीय शंकु nahi kahlaata. NCERT clearly kehti hai: jab tak anyatha na kaha jaaye, ‘शंकु’ se humara matlab right circular cone hi hoga. Board par hamesha teen letters likho: h, r, l — yeh teen cone ke dost hain. Ice-cream cone, joker's topi, traffic cone — sab isi family ke examples hain. Pehle shape pehchano, phir measure, phir formula — yahi classroom order hai.

generated.concept: शंकु का वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल πrl
generated.say: Ab sabse important formula aata hai — शंकु का वक्र पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल. Activity karo: ek ready paper cone lo, use tip se jaati hui kisi side (edge) ke along kaato bina overlapping ke, aur khol do. Jo paper milega woh cake-ke-slice jaisa sector dikhega — yehi curved surface tha! Us edge ke along kaata, wohi slant height l hai. Agar sector ke do radius-edges (A wale) ko fold karke mila do, toh curved arc shuru-shuru mein cone ka circular base banata hai. Ab socho — agar is sector ko tip A se jaati lines se hundreds of tiny strips mein kaat do, toh har strip almost triangle jaisi lagegi, aur har ki height ≈ slant height l. Har chhote triangle ka area = (1/2) × uska base × l. Saare triangles ka area jodne par: (1/2) × l × (saari bases ka sum). Bases ka sum = sector ke curved part ki poori length. Aur yehi curved part cone ka base banata hai, jiski circumference 2πr hoti hai. Isliye CSA = (1/2) × l × 2πr = πrl. Yaad rakho units cm² ya m². Yeh sirf curved lateral surface hai — base ka paper isme shamil nahi. Ice-cream wafer cone ka bahri wrapper area approximately πrl hi hota hai. Board par bada likho: CSA(cone) = π r l. Agar π = 22/7 diya ho aur r = 7 ka multiple ho, calculation soft ho jaati hai — exam mein yeh notice karna marks bachata hai.

generated.say: CSA aa gaya, ab do aur baatein — तिर्यक ऊँचाई l ka relation, aur कुल पृष्ठीय क्षेत्रफल. Right triangle OAB mein, Pythagoras se: slant² = height² + radius², yani l² = h² + r², isliye l = √(r² + h²). Agar sawaal mein h aur r diya ho, pehle l nikaalo, phir CSA. Example: h = 16 cm, r = 12 cm → l = √(16² + 12²) = √(256+144) = √400 = 20 cm. Phir CSA = πrl = 3.14 × 12 × 20 = 753.6 cm². Ab agar cone ka base bhi band rakhna hai — jaise closed conical container — toh ek aur circular paper chahiye area πr². Isliye TSA = CSA + base = πrl + πr² = πr(l + r). Same example mein TSA = 753.6 + 3.14×12×12 = 753.6 + 452.16 = 1205.76 cm². Classroom tip: open tent jaisa open bottom ho toh aksar sirf canvas = CSA; closed solid cone model mein TSA. Units hamesha square. π kabhi 22/7, kabhi 3.14 — jo question bole wahi use karo. Formula card yaad rakho: l = √(r²+h²), CSA = πrl, TSA = πr(l+r). Teen formulae — teen stars of this section.
board_lines: l² = r² + h²  ⇒  l = √(r² + h²)
CSA = πrl
TSA = πrl + πr² = πr(l + r)

generated.say: Ab section 11.2 — गोला, sphere. Pehle sawaal: sphere circle jaisa hai kya? Circle paper par draw ho sakta hai — plane closed figure, har point centre se fixed distance (radius) par. Ab activity: circular disc ke diameter along dori chipkao aur ghumao jaise pehle triangle ghumaaya tha — naya solid milega, ball jaisa — yahi गोला (sphere) hai. Jo centre tha, wahi sphere ka centre ban jaata hai. Definition: sphere space mein un sab points ka set hai jo ek fixed point (centre) se fixed distance (radius r) par hain. Note: 'sphere' aksar surface ko kehte hain (ball ki skin), aur solid ball ko solid sphere/ball. Surface area activity: rubber ball par nail se dori lapeto jab tak poori ball cover ho; phir dori hatao; ball ka diameter measure karke r nikaalo; paper par r-radius ke chaar circles banao aur wahi dori se unhe fill karo. Result: dori jo ek sphere cover karti thi, chaar circles bhar deti hai! Matlab SA(sphere) = 4 × (πr²) = 4πr². Sphere ke kitne faces? Sirf ek — completely curved. Football, orange peel, globe — sab 4πr² family. Example: r = 7 cm → SA = 4×(22/7)×7×7 = 616 cm². Yaad: diameter diya ho toh r = d/2 pehle. Yeh formula Class 9 ka star formula hai — ratta nahi, activity se samjho: four circles wrap one ball.

Ek curved surface, ek flat circular base (diameter wala face). Curved surface area of hemisphere = half of sphere's SA = (1/2)×4πr² = 2πr². Lekin agar dono faces lo — jaise solid hemisphere object ka total outer area — toh TSA = curved + base = 2πr² + πr² = 3πr². Bahut zaroori farq: bowl ke andar paint / dome ke bahar paint mein aksar sirf curved surface chahiye = 2πr²; solid paperweight jaisa closed hemisphere model mein TSA = 3πr². Example: r = 21 cm → CSA = 2×(22/7)×21×21 = 2772 cm²; TSA = 3×(22/7)×21×21 = 4158 cm². Board par side-by-side likho: Sphere 4πr² | Hemisphere CSA 2πr² | Hemisphere TSA 3πr². Numbers 4, 2, 3 — sequence yaad rakhne layak. Thin steel bowl mein internal/external radius alag ho sakte hain — thickness add/subtract karna padta hai; yeh Exercise 11.2 mein aata hai. Pehle clearly poochho: curved only ya total? Class mein ek line aur yaad rakho: hollow hemispherical bowl ke andar kalai/paint = usually inner curved 2πr²; agar rim/base ring alag se na maanga ho toh TSA mat jodna. Solid model paint mein 3πr².
